\ednentry{
  id = {EDN-93},
  title = {A hung API is ended by its healthcheck and restarted by Docker},
  date = {2026-10-22},
  milestone = {M5: Model Packaging},
  topic = {Containerization, Reliability},
  participants = {@lukas2510 decided (\href{https://github.com/mlops-2627q1-mds-upc/MLOPS_Recommenditos/issues/185}{issue \#185})},
  decision = {Compose runs Docker's init in front of the API (\texttt{init: true}).
After the 60 s start period, a probe that gets no answer from \texttt{/\allowbreak{}health} in two attempts of 6 s kills the init's children; the init exits and \texttt{restart: unless-\allowbreak{}stopped} restarts the container.
Known limit: with several workers one hung worker goes unnoticed, so the API runs one worker until the VM's load test (\#143).},
  rationale = {\emph{Alternatives considered:}
\begin{itemize}[leftmargin=*, topsep=2pt]
\item An autoheal sidecar (18.4 s): the Docker socket it needs is root on the host, against the hardening of \#200.
\item A watchdog on the VM (19.2 s): changes to the VM that CI cannot test.
\item gunicorn's worker timeout: catches one hung worker among several, but adds two serving dependencies, does not run on Windows and misses a full threadpool.
\item uvicorn's supervisor: misses a blocked event loop.
\end{itemize}
\par
\emph{Why:} With the server frozen by SIGSTOP, the old stack was still down after 75 s.
A prototype under \#200's hardening recovered in 16.1 s with one worker and 17.2 s with two; the final probe, on the stack without it, in 15.8 to 20.6 s in four runs with one worker and 16.8 s with two.
The worst case is 10 s interval + 2 \ensuremath{\times} 6 s + 4 s restart = 26 s; under load, a kill needs about 128 requests of 47 ms queued ahead of \texttt{/\allowbreak{}health}, more than the load test's 80 users.},
  ai = {Alternative generation, Alternative assessment, Recommendation, Solution generation},
  response = {Accepted},
  assessment = {AI found the options, measured each on the stack or a small test server, and recommended the probe, which @lukas2510 chose.
AI then wrote the probe and a hang drill that fails on the old stack and passes on the new one.},
  aievidence = {Claude Code session of 2026-10-22 on Milestone 5: the measured options for restarting a hung API.},
  evidence = {\href{https://github.com/mlops-2627q1-mds-upc/MLOPS_Recommenditos/issues/185}{Issue \#185}, \href{https://github.com/mlops-2627q1-mds-upc/MLOPS_Recommenditos/blob/main/docs/docs/deployment.md}{deployment docs}, \href{https://github.com/mlops-2627q1-mds-upc/MLOPS_Recommenditos/blob/main/recommenditos/api/healthcheck.py}{\texttt{healthcheck.\allowbreak{}py}}, \href{https://github.com/mlops-2627q1-mds-upc/MLOPS_Recommenditos/blob/main/tests/integration/test_deployed_recovery.py}{hang drill}.},
}
